gzclp.name: GZCLP
gzclp.description: A four-day linear progression using T1, T2 and T3 work, with staged responses to failed sets.

hexan-ppl.name: HeXaN PPL
hexan-ppl.description: A six-day push, pull and legs plan combining 5/3/1 compounds with double-progression accessories.

stronglifts-5x5.name: StrongLifts 5x5
stronglifts-5x5.description: A beginner strength plan with two alternating workouts, linear loading and planned deloads.

phraks-greyskull-lp.name: Phrak's Greyskull LP
phraks-greyskull-lp.description: Two alternating full-body workouts with an AMRAP final set and linear progression.

531-boring-but-big.name: 5/3/1 Boring But Big
531-boring-but-big.description: Four-week 5/3/1 cycles paired with high-volume 5×10 supplemental work.

531-for-beginners.name: 5/3/1 for Beginners
531-for-beginners.description: Three weekly full-body sessions with two main lifts and First Set Last supplemental work.

phul.name: PHUL
phul.description: Four weekly sessions split between heavy power work and higher-repetition hypertrophy.

nivel-7.name: Level 7
nivel-7.description: A twelve-week reverse-periodization strength plan built around a target personal record.

caparazon-de-tortuga.name: Turtle Shell
caparazon-de-tortuga.description: A gradual 200-session path from bodyweight foundations to barbell strength.

365-programmare-lipertrofia.name: 365 Hypertrophy Planning
365-programmare-lipertrofia.description: A year-long hypertrophy plan organized into technique, loading, neural, intensification and isolation phases.

la-sala-del-tiempo.name: The Time Chamber
la-sala-del-tiempo.description: An advanced 196-session hypertrophy cycle with four progressively more intense phases.

sala-del-tiempo-1.name: The Time Chamber 1
sala-del-tiempo-1.description: Six weeks of technical practice using light loads, pauses, tempo and movement control.

sala-del-tiempo-2.name: The Time Chamber 2
sala-del-tiempo-2.description: Thirteen weeks of progressive neural-strength work and load ramping.

sala-del-tiempo-3.name: The Time Chamber 3
sala-del-tiempo-3.description: Eighteen weeks of intensification across three blocks, each ending with a one-rep-max test.

tenkaichi-budokai-sentadilla.name: Tenkaichi Budokai — Squat
tenkaichi-budokai-sentadilla.description: A sixteen-week powerlifting preparation plan emphasizing the squat.

tenkaichi-budokai-press-banca.name: Tenkaichi Budokai — Bench Press
tenkaichi-budokai-press-banca.description: A sixteen-week powerlifting preparation plan emphasizing bench-press volume and variations.

tenkaichi-budokai-peso-muerto.name: Tenkaichi Budokai — Deadlift
tenkaichi-budokai-peso-muerto.description: A sixteen-week powerlifting preparation plan emphasizing deadlift variations.

tenkaichi-budokai-solo-banca.name: Tenkaichi Budokai — Bench Only
tenkaichi-budokai-solo-banca.description: An eighteen-week competition plan focused exclusively on the bench press.

tenkaichi-budokai-veterano.name: Tenkaichi Budokai — Veteran
tenkaichi-budokai-veterano.description: A four-block Sheiko-style preparation plan for experienced powerlifters.

furia-oscura.name: Dark Fury
furia-oscura.description: An alternating push, pull and legs plan using double progression across three weekly sessions.
